source.author: verg
source.text: Quem simul ac Iuturna soror crebrescere vidit sermonem et volgi variare labantia corda, in medias acies, formam assimulata Camerti, cui genus a proavis ingens clarumque paternae nomen erat virtutis, et ipse acerrimus armis, in medias dat sese acies haud nescia rerum rumoresque serit varios ac talia fatur:
source.text_original: Quem simul ac Iuturna soror crebrescere vidit / sermonem et volgi variare labantia corda, / in medias acies, formam assimulata Camerti, / cui genus a proavis ingens clarumque paternae / nomen erat virtutis, et ipse acerrimus armis, / in medias dat sese acies haud nescia rerum / rumoresque serit varios ac talia fatur: /
source.text_english: As soon as Juturna saw this talk growing and the wavering hearts of the crowd changing, she rushed into the middle of the ranks, taking the form of Camers, whose stock from his ancestors was great and whose name was famous for his father’s valor, and who himself was most fierce in arms; she thrusts herself into the middle of the ranks, not unaware of affairs, and spreads varied rumors and speaks thus:

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: cederet his etiam et sese sine honore referret ulterius, sed nube rigens ac nescia rerum stat super et nostros iam zona reverberat ignes.
reuse.text_original: cederet his etiam et sese sine honore referret / ulterius, sed nube rigens ac nescia rerum / stat super et nostros iam zona reverberat ignes.
reuse.text_english: he would even yield to these and withdraw farther, dishonored, but stiffened by a cloud and unaware of events he stands above, and his zone now lashes back our fires.
